description: The components to ask OSV about, as purl@version, the logical source the responses are stated under, and the distro packages (purl types deb, rpm, apk) the SBOM import resolved to an OSV source package. A distro component is asked by that package (ecosystem, source name, version); one without it is never asked, never in queried, and reads not checked.

distro_packages.description: ECOSYSTEM|NAME|VERSION for each distro_purls entry (security.occurrence.osv_package). A purl given two different packages is never asked.

distro_purls.description: The distro components that have an OSV package, one per distro_packages entry, in the same order.

name: security.osv.query.request
